name: Madam Venom
source:
The undisputed leader of a crime empire in the magical metropolis, known by everyone from civilians to career criminals.
This ambitious woman dethroned the "Twin Tower Witch" - formerly the most powerful figure in the city - and now aims to rule the roost herself.
Even inmates in the "Asylum" rehabilitation center count themselves among her loyal followers.

Superpower
Venom is a living, breathing poison factory with an arsenal of toxic tricks up her sleeve.
Her repertoire includes lethal concoctions, mind-bending aphrodisiacs, and sensory enhancers - if you can imagine it, she can brew it.
Her speciality is crafting the perfect blend to bend anyone to her will. A kiss, a touch, or even a whiff of her presence can put you under her spell.
Venom can turn ordinary objects into deadly weapons with just a lick. And here's the kicker - we've yet to see the full extent of her capabilities.
